facts.value: USB Audio Class 2.0 / Yamaha Steinberg USB Driver
The Yamaha Steinberg USB Driver might be required for computer input/output.
Mono (MIC/LINE): 2 including HEADSET MIC; Stereo (LINE): 2; USB IN: 1; AUX IN: 1
STEREO OUT: 1; MONITOR OUT: 1; PHONES: 2 including HEADSET PHONES

facts.note: What the mixer sends to the computer: channels 1 and 2 dry, the stereo mix without the computer's own sound, or the mix with the computer's sound.

setup.en: Turn the mixer to standby before connecting the cables to its [USB 2.0] and [5V DC] terminals, and wake the computer from sleep first.
setup.zh: 接上 [USB 2.0] 和 [5V DC] 端子的線之前，先把混音器切到待機，電腦也先從睡眠醒來。

setup.en: A tablet that cannot power the mixer needs a USB power adapter or a USB battery on the [5V DC] terminal (micro B).
setup.zh: 平板供不了混音器的電時，要在 [5V DC] 端子（micro B）接 USB 電源供應器或行動電源。

setup.en: For a page that listens to the microphone, set [TO PC] to INPUT MIX or DRY CH 1-2.
setup.zh: 要讓網頁聽麥克風時，把 [TO PC] 切到 INPUT MIX 或 DRY CH 1-2。

setup.en: The page must be on https or localhost and start the microphone from a click; on macOS the browser needs microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
setup.zh: 網頁要在 https 或 localhost 上，並且由一次點擊啟動麥克風。在 macOS 上，瀏覽器要在「系統設定 → 隱私權與安全性」裡有麥克風權限。

problems.en: With [TO PC] at LOOPBACK, what the computer plays is mixed into what it receives, so a page that makes sound and listens hears itself; the manual warns that this can loop into feedback.
problems.zh: [TO PC] 在 LOOPBACK 時，電腦播出的聲音會混進它收到的聲音，所以一邊發聲一邊聽的網頁會聽到自己。說明書提醒這可能形成迴路而產生回授。

use.en: Finds the AG06 among the audio inputs by its label and opens it with the browser's voice processing off, only when called.
use.zh: 依名稱在音訊輸入裡找到 AG06，關掉瀏覽器的語音處理後打開它，呼叫了才會做。

use.en: The opened stream feeds the analyzer through input(), so audio/rms, the bands and the drum hits follow the AG06 rather than the default microphone.
use.zh: 打開的串流經 input() 接進分析器，audio/rms、三個頻段和鼓的偵測就跟著 AG06，而不是預設的麥克風。

tbd.en: These are the facts of the first AG06, read from its own documents. The AG06MK2 is another unit, not described here: which of the two this record will be checked on is not confirmed.
tbd.zh: 這些是第一代 AG06 的資料，讀自它自己的文件。AG06MK2 是另一台，這裡沒有描述。這筆紀錄之後會在哪一台上驗證，還沒有確認。

tbd.en: The label patterns were written from the model name, not read from a unit: which label Chrome shows for it on macOS and Windows is not checked.
tbd.zh: 標籤比對式是照型號寫的，不是從實機讀來的。Chrome 在 macOS 與 Windows 上把它叫做什麼，還沒有確認。

tbd.en: Whether a browser gets both USB input channels with channelCount 2 is not checked.
tbd.zh: 瀏覽器設 channelCount 2 時能不能拿到兩個 USB 輸入聲道，還沒有確認。
